name: cainitech
description: Claude plugins that work like an experienced team: application health checks with a 0–100 score, a task workflow from idea to merge, and interface polish.

plugins.name: checkup
plugins.description: Scores an application from 0 to 100 on security, performance, privacy (LGPD) and AI readiness, with a prioritized backlog of findings.

plugins.name: spec
plugins.description: From a loose idea to a merged change: refine tasks, implement them, review and approve — on GitHub or without it.

plugins.name: polish
plugins.description: Makes websites and web apps stop looking AI-generated: builds, redesigns or reviews pages and screens through a design system, using the project's own, improving it, or creating one when there is none.
